teaser: I tried to pay HBR for one article and was offered a subscription. The arithmetic says 24p to 55p; and ten things HBR could sell a reader like me.
core_idea: A reader who wants to pay for one article is offered only subscriptions or a team-priced reprint, while a month's price divided by the month's articles is 24p to 55p; the article is the least of what a publisher could sell, since the graph, the vocabulary, the evidence, versions, the reader's record and a licence to quote with a share are each billable units, most of which run on newsroom.sgit.ai with open reader code.
